_comment: Resource usage per step, measured from Sepolia receipts on the classes that
match the current build (see docs/mainnet.md). Resource *amounts* do not depend
on which network you are on, so these project onto mainnet by repricing them at
'measured' is what the receipt actually charged. 'bound' is what the estimator
demands the account hold before it will submit. The bound is what decides whether
a transaction goes through, and it runs ~38% above measured on the declares.
Fund against bound, expect to be charged measured.

mainnet_estimates._comment: Real starknet_estimateFee against the mainnet RPC, block 13756429, simulation_flags ['SKIP_VALIDATE'], sender borrowed from a recent mainnet block so the nonce resolves. Nothing signed, nothing submitted, no balance required. These supersede the Sepolia reprice: mainnet consumes ~1.10x the Sepolia l2 gas for the same class. NOTE starknet.js's EstimateFee.overall_fee is pre-padded by ~2.05x; these are the node's own overall_fee, read from the raw JSON-RPC result.
mainnet_estimates.sncast_bound_note: sncast demanded 1,437,474,240 l2 gas for a class whose Sepolia receipt charged 1,038,760,640 - a 1.384x margin. Applied to the mainnet estimates that projects to ~48.0 and ~10.5 STRK that must be held, against ~42.3 spent.
